facts.fact: The Legal Assistance Centre's annotated text says the Electronic Transactions Act 4 of 2019 (GG 7068), signed by the President on 7 November 2019, was brought into force on 16 March 2020 by GN 75/2020 (GG 7142), except section 20 (electronic signatures), Chapter 4 (consumer protection) and Chapter 5 (accreditation of security services).

The annotated text says section 20 (recognised electronic signatures) and Chapter 5 (accreditation of security products and services by the Communications Regulatory Authority of Namibia) of the Electronic Transactions Act 4 of 2019 were brought into force on 15 June 2026 by GN 182/2026 (GG 8949); the chapter on online consumer protection (Chapter 4) is annotated as not yet in force.
